ground_truth_evidence: category 5: the dataset's own trigger (newplatform_bundles/conversion/c5/gt/coturn/vulnerability_WF_RAG_9/buf.bin; adapted: the 40 x 'A' buffer exploit_files/prog.c passes to proxy_string_field(field, 16, buf, 0, 40); the driver passes the PoC bytes and their length instead, into a plain 16-byte stack array (ASan cannot see the exploit's overflow into the next struct member))

review.note: output differs (EXPLOIT_TRIGGERED vs NO_TRIGGER), no crash

category5.design: proxy_string_field is static and reached only by PROXY-protocol headers on TCP connections to a running server, so the driver cuts the function out of the build's own ns_ioalib_engine_impl.c (as attack.sh does) and calls it on the PoV bytes with a 16-byte stack field; the crash rule sees the vulnerable one-byte stack overflow.
